name: cosmotask-app
description: CosmoTask - Neumorphic Orbital To-Do Android App with Reminders and Thoughts

scripts.copy:www: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive: true}); ['index.html','style.css','app.js','thoughts.js','config.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); fs.cpSync('assets', 'www/assets', {recursive: true}); console.log('Synced files to www/');"
scripts.sync: npm run copy:www && npx cap sync

author: Sameer
